title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
body: The Embassy of India in Kathmandu is coordinating with Nepalese authorities on search, rescue, and identification after the Nepal floods. Indian nationals and families: Embassy flood support email eoikathmandufloodsupport@gmail.com (CC when sending DNA profiles to dnacodis@nepalpolice.gov.np). Embassy helplines with WhatsApp: +977-9851316807, +977-9709107500, +977-9810326117. MEA Special Control Room, Delhi: +91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719, WhatsApp +91-9968291988, situationroom@mea.gov.in.
